resources.string: Lets FocusBro see which app just came to the foreground, so it can send you back home when a session is running and you open something you have blocked. It reads the app name only — it cannot see your screen, what you type, or what you send. Outside a session it does one thing: from 21:00 to 06:00 it sends you home from browsers, Reddit and Telegram (Night Guard).
